title: Witness and countersigner directory
description: Shape of witnesses.json. Checks JSON Schema cannot express (alphabetical order, a key id listed at most once across both arrays, each public_keys entry hashing to one of its row's key_ids, a countersigner row not declaring independence of itself) are enforced by capsule_emit.witness_directory.

binding.description: How a checkpoint reaches this witness: cll (POST /checkpoints), rekor (a Rekor dsse entry) or scrapi (SCRAPI POST /entries). Absent means cll.

public_keys.description: Base64 DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo of each key that is not Ed25519. Each must hash (SHA-256) to one of the row's key_ids. Required for a rekor row, where every key id is a log ID; the validator also checks each rekor key id has its key here.

countersigners.description: Parties that issue countersignatures over an Evidence Bundle digest. A verifier resolves a countersignature's signer.key_id against these rows' key_ids. Optional; absent means no countersigners are listed.

key_ids.description: Full 32-byte Ed25519 public keys, 64 lowercase hex characters: the form countersignatures[].signer.key_id carries. More than one when the operator has rotated keys.

statement_types_issued.description: Registered Evidence Bundle countersignature types this operator issues, e.g. countersign/v1.

independent_of.description: The operator's own declaration of parties it is under no common control with. A declaration, not a finding: a verifier computes the independence of each countersignature from its signer key, never from this list.

name.description: The operator's self-declared name, or the service's host name when it declares none. Rows are ordered by it.

endpoint.description: Absolute https URL of the service; no credentials, query, or fragment.

key_ids.description: 64 lowercase hex characters per key: a 32-byte Ed25519 public key, or for any other key type the SHA-256 of its DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo (listed in public_keys). More than one when the operator has rotated keys.

since.description: Date the service began issuing at this endpoint (receipts for a witness, countersignatures for a countersigner), YYYY-MM-DD.
